_readme: Copy to ci.config.json next to this file or to ~/.claude/ci.config.json and fill the <PLACEHOLDERS>. A value still in <angle brackets> is treated as unset. Labels, statuses and colors are yours to change.

labels.title: CI routing
labels.no_route: no route: the repo's own CI applies

backends.label: GitHub Actions (hosted)
backends.notes: Works for public repos only; private repos are refused for billing.

backends.label: GitLab.com shared runners
backends.notes: Shared SaaS runners, 400 CI minutes a month for the group. Untagged jobs land here.

backends.label: GitLab runner on this PC
backends.notes: Self-hosted runner on your own PC; jobs must carry the local-windows tag. Also runs CI for private GitHub repos through a GitLab mirror.

backends.label: GitLab runner on the Oracle VM
backends.notes: Self-hosted GitLab runner on an Oracle VM; not set up yet.

backends.label: GitHub runner on the Oracle VM
backends.notes: Self-hosted GitHub Actions runner on an Oracle VM; not set up yet.
